presentation: A 27-year-old woman has had persistently mild thrombocytopenia for 3 years, with platelet counts ranging from about 100k to 150k per microliter. Her count is currently 120k. She reports that the low counts first appeared after a postpartum hemorrhage. She has no history of liver disease, splenomegaly, transfusions, or a family history of blood disorders. Other blood counts, kidney function, and basic labs have been unremarkable. What is the recommended management for her thrombocytopenia?
